useCases.title: Save booking as Draft
mainFlow: 1. An agent can save a booking request as Draft and complete it later.
2. Drafts are invisible to officers.

useCases.title: Mandatory fields to submit
mainFlow: 1. The booking form requires vessel, berth, ETA, ETD and cargo class before it can be submitted.

useCases.title: Submission validation
mainFlow: 1. ETD must be later than ETA.
2. The system rejects a stay longer than 30 days.
3. A booking request cannot be submitted more than 90 days before the ETA.
4. A booking request must be submitted at least 48 hours before the ETA.

useCases.title: Unique, permanent booking reference on submission
postconditions: BookingRequest.Reference assigned in format HB-YYYY-NNNNN; Status = Submitted
mainFlow: 1. On submission the system assigns a unique booking reference in the format HB-YYYY-NNNNN.
2. The reference is never reused, even after a request is cancelled or deleted — a cancelled request keeps its reference for the audit trail.

useCases.title: Status model
mainFlow: 1. A booking request moves through: Draft, Submitted, Under Review, Approved, Rejected, Cancelled, Completed.

useCases.title: Fast-track automatic approval
preconditions: Berth free for the whole requested stay
mainFlow: 1. A booking request is automatically approved when the requested berth is free for the whole stay and the vessel is shorter than 120 metres.

useCases.title: Edit a Submitted request until review starts
mainFlow: 1. An agent may edit a Submitted request until an officer opens it for review, after which it is locked.

useCases.title: Cancellation and its fee (CONFLICT — see F003-Q1)
mainFlow: 1. An Approved booking may be cancelled by the agent; a Completed booking cannot be cancelled.
2. ch10 states cancellation is free of charge until 24 hours before ETA.
3. ch19 states cancellations made within 72 hours of ETA are charged 50% of the berth fee.
4. ADOPTED (Ruling R3, PROJECT.md): the 72-hour/50% rule (ch19) governs; ch10's 24-hour wording is treated as superseded prose, flagged for a human to confirm or overturn.
validations: Cancellation within 72h of ETA -> 50% berth fee charged

useCases.title: Status-change e-mail to agent
mainFlow: 1. The agent receives an e-mail whenever the status of their booking request changes.
2. ADOPTED (Ruling R9): the e-mail includes the booking Reference, per workshop-notes.md session 2.

useCases.title: Officer daily digest
mainFlow: 1. Officers receive a daily digest at 06:00 listing requests with an ETA within the next 48 hours.

useCases.title: Navigation screen set (CONFLICT — see F003-Q2)
mainFlow: 1. ch28 states the navigation offers three screens: Booking Board, My Bookings and Inspection Calendar.
2. The prototype screenshots (ch08, ch09, ch21) show five nav items: Booking Board, My Bookings, Inspections, Tariffs, Reports.
3. ADOPTED (Ruling R4): built to the 5-item prototype nav — direct UI evidence outranks ch28's prose.

useCases.title: Booking Board filters and ordering
mainFlow: 1. The Booking Board can be filtered by terminal, status and ETA date range.
2. Officers work from a Booking Board that lists Submitted and Under Review requests ordered by ETA.

useCases.title: My Bookings — agent's own requests, Drafts first
mainFlow: 1. My Bookings shows the agent's own requests only, with Draft requests listed first.

useCases.title: Cargo manifest attachment (SHAPE-CHANGING GAP — see F003-Q3)
mainFlow: 1. workshop-notes.md session 2: agents must be able to attach the cargo manifest as a PDF to a booking request.
2. Attachment size limit explicitly 'not decided' in the same note.
3. Not modelled in any formal chapter (ch07 domain overview has no file relation for BookingRequest).

useCases.title: AIS position feed flags a booking Arrived
mainFlow: 1. The system imports vessel positions from the AIS feed every 5 minutes.
2. A booking is flagged Arrived when the vessel enters the port geofence.

microflows.name: ACT_BookingRequest_Submit
microflows.purpose: Validates timing/length rules, assigns the permanent Reference, sets Status=Submitted or Approved (fast-track).

microflows.name: SUB_BookingRequest_AssignReference
microflows.purpose: Generates the next HB-YYYY-NNNNN reference, never reused.

pages.name: BookingBoard_Overview
pages.purpose: Officer queue: Submitted+UnderReview, filter by terminal/status/ETA, ordered by ETA

integrations.name: AIS position feed
integrations.type: unspecified (named only, not specified per source-sufficiency)
integrations.stubBehaviour: Poll every 5 minutes; flag booking Arrived on geofence entry (behaviour only; no protocol/auth/failure-mode documented).
integrations.realTarget: AIS feed (no contract in the source)

openQuestions.question: Cancellation-fee window conflict C1 (ch10 24h-free vs ch19 72h/50%).
openQuestions.answer: ch19's 72h/50% rule adopted as authoritative (Ruling R3).

openQuestions.question: Navigation count conflict C2 (ch28 says 3 screens; prototype shows 5).
openQuestions.answer: Built to the 5-item prototype nav (Ruling R4).
